serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Bizzdesign GovCloud is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) offering of our Alfabet solution, hosted in AWS GovCloud through dedicated (single) tenant environments for U.S. government agencies. Bizzdesign Alfabet includes industry-leading capabilities that accelerate business transformation and improve time-to-market for key initiatives.

Bizzdesign Alfabet specializes in five solutions under one platform during your transformation journey:
•        Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)
•        Application Portfolio Management (APM)
•        Technology Portfolio Management (TPM)
•        Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM)
•        Business Architecture Management (BAM)

Bizzdesign Alfabet's unique capabilities include:
•        Portfolio-Wide Visibility & Analysis
•        Lean Portfolio Management
•        AI-Enhanced Portfolio Decision-Making
•        Value Accelerators Library
•        Smart Data Management
•        Executive-Ready Reporting
•        Scalability for any agency
•        Flexible Implementation and Onboarding

Bizzdesign Alfabet had been FedRAMP-authorized since 2020 under the ARIS FedRAMP Cloud Service Provider (CSP) listing, and we are proud to continue supporting the federal government market.
